name: Biddy Early

attributes.attribute: healer known as the White Witch of Clare
a real woman of the eastern part of County Clare

sources: Lenihan, Edmund. *In Search of Biddy Early.* Cork: Mercier Press, 1987.
Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Biddy Early was an Irish folk heroine. People called her the White Witch of Clare. She was a healer in the eastern part of County Clare in the 19th century. Her name still stands a century and a half later. She was a real woman of the parish of Feakle in the Slieve Aughty hills. The fairies were said to have given her a magical blue bottle. She looked into it to learn the cause of an illness. She often clashed with the local clergy. When she died she threw the bottle into a stream. Locals say it still rests there today.

okr.objective: Biddy Early is a folk heroine based on a real healer from County Clare, remembered by the white bottle legend.
